description: Dollar Tree, Inc. is a leading operator of retail discount stores operating under the brand names of Dollar Tree and Dollar Tree Canada, and at January 31, 2026 it operated approximately 9,000 stores across 48 states and the District of Columbia and approximately 275 stores across seven Canadian provinces. It believes the convenience and value it offers, as well as the thrill-of-the-hunt shopping experience where customers discover new celebratory and seasonal items every week, are key factors in serving and growing its base of loyal customers, and it continues to execute strategic initiatives to drive profitable growth as a standalone banner following the sale of Family Dollar, including an expanded and more relevant assortment, agile cost management, a more connected customer experience in stores, new store growth, and improved store conditions and operations supported by an evolving supply chain.
